useWhen: Observe sealed inbox metadata through an authorized mail-relay client; use for delivery and relay health checks.
avoidWhen: Reading plaintext, decrypting messages, sending mail or rotating identities

outputs.observation: metadata counts and delivery gaps without message contents

authority.binding: caller authorization and owner-reviewed target repository policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; wildcard versions do not establish installation or runtime qualification. Bind source dependencies and effective permissions in the owning repository.
